body: STARLUX Airlines said the Chinese Professional Baseball League combined team will take flight JX800 to Tokyo, Japan, on November 10 to take part in the 2026 Asia Professional Baseball Championship, which is scheduled to begin on November 12 at Tokyo Dome. STARLUX specially arranged its AIRSORAYAMA Gold art aircraft to operate the flight and invited fans to take the same flight to cheer for Team Taiwan. The support theme for the flight is Fly In GOLD! Go For Gold!, and STARLUX prepared support items for the combined team and for passengers on the flight. STARLUX also arranged for cabin crew member 張甄芸, who holds the status of a women's national baseball player, to serve as a working crew member on the flight, joining all crew members in cheering for the combined team.

The combined team first selected a 33-person training roster, began training on November 1 at Xinzhuang Baseball Stadium, and planned warm-up games on November 7 against the Wei Chuan Dragons and on November 8 against the CTBC Brothers. STARLUX said it hoped that, through the art aircraft and support activities, it could express support and good wishes for the team's campaign and invite fans to accompany the players to Tokyo.
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines will fly the CPBL combined team to Tokyo on flight JX800 on November 10 for the 2026 Asia Professional Baseball Championship, with its AIRSORAYAMA Gold art aircraft operating the flight.
en.title: STARLUX art aircraft to fly CPBL combined team to Tokyo for Asia championship

body: 星宇航空表示，中職聯隊將於11月10日搭乘JX800班機前往日本東京，參加2026年亞洲職棒冠軍爭霸賽；本屆賽事將於11月12日在東京巨蛋開打。星宇航空特別安排「AIRSORAYAMA Gold空山金」藝術機執飛該班機，並邀請球迷搭乘同一班機赴日為台灣隊加油。該班機的應援主題為「Fly In GOLD! Go For Gold!」，星宇航空也為中職聯隊與該班機乘客準備應援小物，並安排具女子國家隊棒球選手身分的空服員張甄芸擔任該班機執勤組員，與全體組員一同為中職聯隊加油。
中職聯隊先選出33人培訓名單，於11月1日在新莊棒球場展開集訓，並預定於11月7日、11月8日分別與味全龍、中信兄弟進行熱身賽。星宇航空表示，希望透過藝術機與應援活動表達對球隊參賽的支持與祝福，並邀請球迷搭乘同一班機陪同球員前往東京參賽。
zh.summary: 星宇航空表示，中職聯隊將於11月10日搭乘JX800班機前往東京，參加2026年亞洲職棒冠軍爭霸賽，執飛的「AIRSORAYAMA Gold空山金」藝術機將為球隊助陣。
zh.title: 星宇藝術機助陣，中職聯隊11月10日搭JX800赴東京戰亞冠賽
